correctness.rationale: The source factorization gives lambda1=r1>0 and a quadratic with sum B1<0 and product B2>0. Vieta plus the real/conjugate dichotomy forces negative real parts for the other two eigenvalues. Thus P4 is hyperbolic with one unstable direction; a saddle-node requires a zero eigenvalue.
